name: Lobbied
tagline: Who pays Washington, how much, and what they got.
scope: Federal and state lobbying spending, campaign and PAC money, revolving-door hires and resulting rule or bill changes for the named industries. Excludes individual-donor gossip and unsourced influence claims.
major: a new FEC or LDA filing over $1M; a federal rule change that follows named lobbying; an indictment or plea in a corruption case; a fine or settlement of $10M+
watch: quarterly FEC and LDA deadlines; pending rulemakings; ethics complaints
search_queries: lobbying bribery indicted OR pleads guilty
